fusions.name: Outbound Chirps
fusions.desc: Looses 3 pulses of sound at once, spread apart, and each deals 3 damage. You heal for 20% of the damage they deal, spread over the following 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spiral Descent
fusions.desc: Swoops you to a target up to 7 tiles away and bites it. The bite deals 13 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Orbiting Colony
fusions.desc: Summons a swarm that circles you for 12 seconds. Every second it bites an enemy within 3 tiles and deals 3 damage, and each kill made while it circles restores 2 health to you.

fusions.name: Fed by Motion
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your attacks drain 20% of the damage they deal back to you as health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
